spans.s: Joined, connected. -Comp. -व्याध a. surrounded or joined by huntsmen; Ks.
Contact, being mixed with, coming in contact with; व्यालनिलयमिलनेन गरलमिव कलयति मलयसमीरम्
Closing of the eyes, winking, twinkling.
(In Rhet.) A concealed simile; see मीलित below.
मिलपत्रः [milapatrḥ], N. of a plant (Mar. आपटा); Gīrvāṇa.

Assembled, gathered (for मिलित). -तम् (In Rhet.) A figure of speech in which the difference or distinction between two objects is shown to be completely obscured on account of their similarity, whether natural or artificial, in some respects; it is thus defined by Mammaṭa: समेन लक्ष्मणा वस्तु वस्तुना यन्निगूह्यते । निजेनागन्तुना वापि तन्मीलितमिति स्मृतम् ॥ K.
मिलिन्दः [milindḥ], A bee; परिणतमकरन्दमार्मिकास्ते जगति भवन्तु चिरायुषो मिलिन्दाः
मिलीमिलिन् [milīmilin], m. An epithet of Śiva.
To join, be united with, accompany; रुमण्वतो मिलितः
To come or meet together, meet, gather, assemble; ये चान्ये सुहृदः समृद्धिसमये द्रव्याभिलाषाकुलास्ते सर्वत्र मिलन्ति
; याताः किं न मिलन्ति Amaru 1; मिलित- शिलीमुख &c.
; स पात्रेसमितो$न्यत्र भोजनान्मिलितो न यः Trik.
To be mixed or united with, come in contact with; मिलति तव तोयैर्मृगमदः G.
To meet or encounter (as in fighting); close, close with.
To find, fall in with. -Caus. (मेलयति-ते) To bring together, assemble, convene.
To close (as the eyes), close or contract the eye-lids, wink, twinkle; पत्रे बिभ्यति मीलति क्षणमपि क्षिप्रं तदालोकनात्
To close, be closed or shut (as eyes or flowers); नयनयुगममीलत् Śi. 11.2; तस्या मिमीलतुर्नेत्रे
To fade, disappear, vanish; कालेन मीलितधियामवमृश्य नॄणाम्
To meet or be collected (for मिल्). -Caus. (मीलयति-ते) To cause to shut, close, shut (eyes, flowers &c.); न लोचनं मीलयितुं विषेहे
; शेषान् मासान् गमय चतुरो लोचने मीलयित्वा
